parameters.name: ConfigId
parameters.description: The configuration ID. You can call the [ListRewriteUrlRules](~~2867480~~) operation to obtain the configuration ID.

parameters.name: RewriteQueryStringType
parameters.description:
The query character string rewrite type. Valid values:
- static: static pattern.
- dynamic: dynamic pattern.

parameters.name: RewriteUriType
parameters.description:
The path rewrite type. Valid values:
- static: static pattern.
- dynamic: dynamic pattern.

parameters.name: Rule
parameters.description:
The rule content. A conditional expression is used to match user requests. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration. Two scenarios are supported:
- Match all incoming requests: Set the value to true.
- Match specified requests: Set the value to a custom expression, for example, (http.host eq \"video.example.com\").

parameters.name: RuleEnable
parameters.description:
The rule switch. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration. Valid values:
- on: Enabled.
- off: Disabled.

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description: The rule name. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration.

parameters.name: Sequence
parameters.description: The rule execution order. A smaller value indicates a higher priority.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation to obtain the site ID.
